description:
Get the authenticated Instagram professional account's profile, and the server's active capabilities.

Returns username, account type, follower/following/media counts, bio and website, plus which Meta auth mode this server is running in and what that mode cannot do.

Call this first in a new session: it tells you the account ID to pass to other tools and whether hashtag search and business discovery are available at all.

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the account the access token belongs to, which is the normal case.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_get_account
title: Get Account
